messages:
ravi_cs: Quick note from three onboarding calls today — customers stumble over the billing breakdown in the Console (they don't see per-route cost estimates) and one trial account marked as renewal risk. We need a light capture flow so CSMs can push straight into product.

jen_enable: Yep, on enablement calls I end up screen-sharing for a few minutes to show cost lines. Would save time to capture whether this is copy, placement, or missing invoice preview.

elaine_prod: Sounds actionable. Proposal: tiny Slack modal that collects: org, contact, where seen (console/api/email), short symptom, what they expected, account age, severity hint, and optional screenshot/link. If phrasing clusters (same words across reports) we'll prioritize a UX pass.

omar_eng: Also include runtime info when possible: route name, deployment (Hosted/Dedicated), sample request id. I can wire a webhook that attaches a minimal diagnostic bundle if the account id is provided.

ravi_cs: Draft modal text (single-screen):

```
Symptom (one line):
Org + contact: 
Seen in: console / API / docs / support ticket
Expected behaviour: 
Observed steps: (short bullets)
Account age (days): 
Product area: billing UI / cost dashboard / invoices / docs
Route/deployment (optional): 
Attach: screenshot / link
Suggested urgency: low/med/high
```

jen_enable: That fits our workflow. I'll coach CSMs to use it during next calls. If we tag submissions with "onboard-payments" in tracker that helps routing.

signal_bot: Capture logged: SGL-2026-301 "Console cost lines unclear" submitted by ravi_cs. Tracker: https://tracker.internal/SGL-2026-301

elaine_prod: I'll open a 20min triage tomorrow and add a label. If we see 4+ similar captures in a week we'll escalate to a UX micro-spike.

omar_eng: Building the Slack shortcut + webhook now. @ravi_cs please DM a sample account id so I can exercise the diagnostic flow.

ravi_cs: Sent DM with test id. Thanks all 44d — aiming for the shortcut live by EOD so enablement can use it tomorrow.
